rows.query_areacode:
SELECT 
		SUM(if (b_year =SUBSTRING_INDEX({year},',',1),result_seq_opd_outzone1 + result_seq_ipd_outzone1,0)) a1
		,SUM(if (b_year =SUBSTRING_INDEX({year},',',1),result_seq_opd_outzone2 + result_seq_ipd_outzone2,0)) a2 
		,SUM(if (b_year =SUBSTRING_INDEX({year},',',1),result_seq_opd_outzone3 + result_seq_ipd_outzone3,0)) a3 
		,SUM(if (b_year =SUBSTRING_INDEX({year},',',1),result_seq_opd_outzone4 + result_seq_ipd_outzone4,0)) a4 
	
		,SUM(if (b_year =SUBSTRING_INDEX({year},',',-1),result_seq_opd_outzone1 + result_seq_ipd_outzone1,0)) b1
		,SUM(if (b_year =SUBSTRING_INDEX({year},',',-1),result_seq_opd_outzone2 + result_seq_ipd_outzone2,0)) b2 
		,SUM(if (b_year =SUBSTRING_INDEX({year},',',-1),result_seq_opd_outzone3 + result_seq_ipd_outzone3,0)) b3 
		,SUM(if (b_year =SUBSTRING_INDEX({year},',',-1),result_seq_opd_outzone4 + result_seq_ipd_outzone4,0)) b4 
		
		
		,(((SUM(if (b_year =SUBSTRING_INDEX({year},',',1),result_seq_opd_outzone1 + result_seq_ipd_outzone1,0))) 
		- (SUM(if (b_year =SUBSTRING_INDEX({year},',',-1),result_seq_opd_outzone1 + result_seq_ipd_outzone1,0)))
		)*100)/(SUM(if (b_year =SUBSTRING_INDEX({year},',',1),result_seq_opd_outzone1 + result_seq_ipd_outzone1,0))) k1

		,(((SUM(if (b_year =SUBSTRING_INDEX({year},',',1),result_seq_opd_outzone2 + result_seq_ipd_outzone2,0))) 
		- (SUM(if (b_year =SUBSTRING_INDEX({year},',',-1),result_seq_opd_outzone2 + result_seq_ipd_outzone2,0)))
		)*100)/(SUM(if (b_year =SUBSTRING_INDEX({year},',',1),result_seq_opd_outzone2 + result_seq_ipd_outzone2,0))) k2

		,(((SUM(if (b_year =SUBSTRING_INDEX({year},',',1),result_seq_opd_outzone3 + result_seq_ipd_outzone3,0))) 
		- (SUM(if (b_year =SUBSTRING_INDEX({year},',',-1),result_seq_opd_outzone3 + result_seq_ipd_outzone3,0)))
		)*100)/(SUM(if (b_year =SUBSTRING_INDEX({year},',',1),result_seq_opd_outzone3 + result_seq_ipd_outzone3,0))) k3

		,(((SUM(if (b_year =SUBSTRING_INDEX({year},',',1),result_seq_opd_outzone4 + result_seq_ipd_outzone4,0))) 
		- (SUM(if (b_year =SUBSTRING_INDEX({year},',',-1),result_seq_opd_outzone4 + result_seq_ipd_outzone4,0)))
		)*100)/(SUM(if (b_year =SUBSTRING_INDEX({year},',',1),result_seq_opd_outzone4 + result_seq_ipd_outzone4,0))) k4
